reuse.why: Introduces a shared category query (getMonthActionCategories) and predicate (shouldSetMonthBudget) and routes setZero and the 3/6/12-month averages through them, replacing three copied queries; copyPreviousMonth does not reuse them.

duplication.why: The saved-template CASE expression is written twice (getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories) and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden/group-hidden/template/income check parallel to shouldSetMonthBudget.

placement.why: Selection and policy sit in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them, consistent with the tree; the rule is in one module, though split across two code paths.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their category selection and a test are changed.

maintainability.why: Most actions now share one policy function, a clear improvement, but a future exclusion must still be added to both shouldSetMonthBudget and the copyPreviousMonth branch plus both SQL queries.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No pre-existing month-action policy existed; copyPreviousMonth simply does not adopt the new one (see duplication).

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts re-expresses shouldSetMonthBudget as two separate if-guards (income, then hidden||group_hidden||has_saved_templates), and the template CASE SQL is repeated in getBudgetData.

one_place.where: setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg use shouldSetMonthBudget/getMonthActionCategories, but copyPreviousMonth applies the rule through its own inline checks over getBudgetData's own template CASE.
